senses.gloss: (b. h.; v. גדל II) to be high, to grow, be large, tall.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:27">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>שהיה גָדֵל שלא וכ׳</he> he was extraordinarily tall for his age.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:27">Ib.</cite> <he>וכי אין הכל גְּדֵילִים</he> do not all children grow?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 1:3:4">Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="I00633"><he>טְפוּס</he></cite>; a. fr. Fem. <cite ref="C00207"><he>גְּדֵילָה</he></cite>, pl. <he>גְּדֵילוֹת</he>.

senses.gloss: to raise (of live stock and of plants); to rear, train.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 8:1">Kil. VIII, 1</cite> <he>מותרים לגַדֵּל</he> you are permitted to raise.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 19b:13">Ib.</cite>; <cite ref="Megillah 13a:5">Meg. 13ᵃ</cite> <he>המְגַדֵּל יתום וכ׳</he> he who educates an orphan in his house.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 98">Gen. R. s. 98</cite> <he>היו … מְגַדְּלִים שער</he> they let their hair grow (in mourning).
<cite ref="Eruvin 100b:26">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>מְגַדָּלֶת שער</he> she lets her hair grow (does not cut it); a. fr.

senses.gloss: to raise to dignity, make famous; to praise.
units: <cite ref="Horayot 9a:2">Hor. 9ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 21:10">Lev. XXI, 10</cite>) whence do we know <he>אם אין לו שחייבין לגַדְּלוֹ</he> when he (the Highpriest) is poor, that they (the brethren) are bound to raise him (make him independent)? <cite ref="Leviticus 21:10">Ib.</cite> <he>גַּדְּלֵהוּ משל אחיו</he> raise him by a collection from his brethren (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).

Esth. R. to III, 1 למה גִדְּלוֹ for what purpose did (the Lord) raise him? Yalk. Esth. 1053 עד היכן גִּידְּלוֹ וכ׳ how high did he raise him? Fifty cubits (to the gallows); a. fr.—Y. Meg. III, end, 74ᶜ (ref. to הגדול, Neh. VIII, 6) במה גִידְּלוֹ wherewith did he magnify the Lord (describe His greatness)?; Yoma 69ᵇ ג׳ בשם וכ׳ he praised the Lord by pronouncing the tetragrammaton; Y. Ber. VII, 11ᶜ גודלו (corr. acc.)—Part. pass. מְגוּדָּל well grown.

senses.gloss: to grow up, to become of age.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 10:9">Yeb. X, 9</cite> <he>וּמִשֶּׁהִ׳</he> and after he is of age.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 13:1">Ib. XIII, 1</cite> <he>עד שתַּגְדִּיל</he> until she becomes of age; a. fr.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 7:1">Esth. R. to III, 1</cite> <he>יִתְגַּדֵּל ואח״כ יתלה</he> let him first become great and then be hanged.

Gen. R. s. 99, end (play on פֹּרָת, Gen. XLIX, 22) ע״י פָּרוֹת נ׳ by means of cows (Pharaoh’s dream) was he raised to power; a. fr.— to be magnified. Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵃ top; Y. Taan. I, 64ᵇ top יִתְגַּדֵּל וכ׳ may Thy Name be glorified, sanctified &c.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to glorify one’s self, to boast, parade.
units: <cite ref="Nedarim 62a">Ned. 62ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:5">Ab. IV, 5</cite> <he>אל תעשם עטרה להִתְגַּדֵּל בהם</he> make them (the words of the Law) not a crown to parade therewith.

senses.gloss: to grow, prosper, be nursed. Tanḥ. V’zoth 1; Pesik. ib. p. 199ᵃ הרי … מִתְגַּדֵּל עמו the poison-bearing tree will be nursed along with it (the health-giving tree). Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Genesis 7">B’resh. 7</cite> <he>נִתְגַּדַּלְתָּ וחטאת</he> thou didst grow older and didst sin, opp. <he>תינוק היית</he>; a. fr.
